description: This script generates C++ code for overlay widgets based on a JSON configuration, used in the ANGLE project for rendering overlays.

classes.name: OverlayWidget
classes.description: Represents an overlay widget with properties parsed from JSON, including type, color, coordinates, and description for graphs.

methods.name: extract_type_and_constructor
methods.description: Extracts the widget type and constructor string from properties.

methods.name: get_font_size_constant
methods.description: Returns the font size constant based on properties.

methods.name: is_graph_type
methods.description: Checks if the widget type is a graph type.

methods.name: is_text_type
methods.description: Checks if the widget type is a text type.

methods.name: OverlayWidget.__init__
methods.description: Initializes an OverlayWidget instance, parsing properties and handling graph descriptions.

methods.name: extract_common
methods.description: Extracts common properties like color, coords, font, and size from widget properties.

methods.name: is_negative_coord
methods.description: Determines if a coordinate is negative based on widget alignment.

methods.name: set_alignment_flags
methods.description: Sets alignment flags for widget positioning based on coordinates.

methods.name: get_offset_helper
methods.description: Calculates offset and alignment for widget positioning.

methods.name: get_bounding_box_coords
methods.description: Calculates bounding box coordinates based on offset and width.

methods.name: generate_widget_init_helper
methods.description: Generates initialization code for a widget.

methods.name: generate_widget_init
methods.description: Generates full initialization code for a widget, including description if graph.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to read JSON layout, generate overlay widget code, and write output file.
